description: Bounded three-trial nearest-union probe of the tied positional table
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,429 parameters at 99.080000%, a +0.080000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 94 prior macro-attempts in this family and 726 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0196/micro-0003 at 1,429 parameters and 99.08%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002, an FF-output union discarded at 98.91%. This macro tests at most three sequential minimum-distance scalar unions in the tied positional table, excluding unchanged positional pairs already rejected. Hypothesis: the positional encoding has a distinct sensitivity profile and may contain additional low-distortion redundancy after token and FF-input compression. This is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because each trial selects the current least-distorting eligible positional union, offering a tensor-site contrast with the token successes under a strict three-trial adaptive bound. Stop at the first discard/error, exhaustion, or cap; official acceptance and rollback remain solely controlled by the runner.
summary: All three bounded positional unions qualified, reducing the retained frontier from 1,429 to 1,426 parameters; the final authorized trial retained 99.100000%. The automation stopped exactly at its declared three-trial cap.
